name: Return to Bodley

guaranteedRewards.name: Brazier of Invocation
tooltip: Use: Summon the spirits of the dead at haunted locations. (10 Min Cooldown)

statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
I will ignore your impertinence this time, champion, because you have done a noble thing today; returning the rest of my stolen spirit to me. Despite your obviously weak nature, friend, you have shown courage where those that stole from me did not, and probably never could!

Return to them, before I change my mind and slay you where you stand. Go back and tell them that they are safe... for now.
narrative.objectives: Return to Bodley inside Blackrock Mountain and give him the Brazier of Beckoning.
narrative.offerRewardText:
He really said all of that? Wow, I can't believe he's going to call off the spectral assassins and stalkers, even if he did hint at causing my living companions further harm in the future.

This is a great day, adventurer! You've accomplished what few ever could, and absolved us, at least in part, of some of our past sins.

Thank you! As a sign of appreciation, I'd like to give you this. You can use it to summon forth spirits at the same haunted locations that you already have, and a few others, too.
narrative.requestItemsText:
adventurer, you're back and still alive! Well, at least that makes one of us.

You're going to have to tell me all about it!
